limitations: All appreciation is retrospective indicative USD price, not modeled executable net return; no $50 liquidity/fee/path claim follows from OHLC volume.
Rankings use the same exact recorded run periods and wholly contained eligible minute bars. Boundary minutes and research interruptions are excluded from in-run ranking.
Missing minute bars are left missing; exact endpoint pairs may still have missing interior bars and are labeled. No crossing time or continuous price path is invented.
Indexed creation is provisional for leads without original onchain proof. Canonical address matching alone cannot prove historical supported mint/vault/fee state.
Current-indexed discovery is incomplete, survivor/current-volume biased and not ordered reliably by historical economic strength; owner-nominated SI is a separate case.
No flow qualification, independent human count, executable exit or profitability can be reconstructed from these prices alone.
Top performers that subsequently collapse remain included; decline from a recorded high is an indicative comparison, not an assumed short or exit fill.
Later retrieved independent data is never backdated into original POE decisions.
